headline: On November 10, 2006: National Museum of the Marine Corps opens
captionCards: Honors Marines through permanent exhibits and memorials
instagramCaption:
The National Museum of the Marine Corps opened in Quantico, Virginia.

President George W. Bush dedicated the museum and announced Jason Dunham would receive the Medal of Honor posthumously.
Located near Marine Corps Base Quantico, it draws over 500,000 visitors annually.
It is now one of Virginia’s top tourist attractions.

Its legacy lives on as a tribute to Marines and a hub for military history.
